review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: As the project’s system technical lead, the role owns the key system decisions, defines requirements and architecture, drives verification and validation, and coaches the mid-level engineers and interns in the System Team. Define, analyze, and manage system requirements throughout the product lifecycle. Break IVI features (media, navigation, phone, smartphone projection, voice, OTA updates) down into use cases and system and subsystem requirements. Perform requirements traceability, impact analysis, and change management. Work with internal and external stakeholders to ensure customer and regulatory requirements are met. Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in automotive product development, including experience as a technical lead. Requirements engineering and system architecture development. Requirements tools: IBM DOORS / DOORS Next, Polarion.
